claim: Town of the Year is a Chill challenge with an 80-day limit: population 100 and satisfy Happiness, with everyone settled as the optional objective. Chill does not mean unlimited days.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Challenge categories and a Chill day limit (A4)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/challenges/ (challenges-menu-chill, challenges-menu-chill-card).

notes: Matches the stored 80-day limit for this map. The in-game Challenges screen describes Redux as familiar levels with a twist, Bounty as producing or stocking as much of a resource as possible within a time limit, and Original as new handcrafted campaign-like levels; ranked Original challenges are timed in days.
